premises: Mesoscale chemical and defect heterogeneities exist in as-deposited FeMnNiGeSi HEAs
These heterogeneities create a broad distribution of local magnetic exchange interactions
This distribution controls the magnetostructural transition, causing a sharp, hysteretic entropy change
Low-temperature annealing reduces chemical heterogeneities and defect densities
Reduced heterogeneity narrows the exchange distribution, broadening the transition and reducing hysteresis
